items.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Office - Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-124194
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Office
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-24
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-111560
廠商: Barracuda Networks
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
說明: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606
